sara: quick q — planning to share a small sample of user query logs with a vendor for model evaluation. Can we send a subset after redaction? what data classification does that fall under? cc @ben-security
ben-security: short answer: maybe. logs that contain PII are HIGH risk. we need to remove direct identifiers (emails, phones, ssn). hashed IDs alone aren't sufficient unless salt + process documented. also require access approval + vendor contract clauses. :shield:
chris-eng: do we have a standard checklist i can run before the upload? i can add pre-upload filters into the pipeline.
ben-security: yes — follow minimalization + encryption in transit. request approval via /approvals and attach a redaction report + sample. basic steps: 
```
- drop fields: email, phone_number, ssn, full_name
- replace user/display names with [REDACTED_NAME]
- truncate free-text context to 200 chars
- remove geolocation coordinates and full addresses
- run PII detector and include results
```
julie-privacy: also run the pii-scan v2 detector and include the scan output. threshold: if >0.1% of tokens flagged as PII, escalate to CISO for review.
mike: if we remove those fields, is the dataset "low" or still "restricted"? curious about how to tag it in the console.
ben-security: conservative default: classify as "restricted_production" unless you can prove zero PII after automated + manual checks. even then, vendor handling requires DPA + SOC2 or equivalent.
chris-eng: ok. i'll implement the redaction steps and generate the scan. will we need to rotate the salt if we hash ids?
julie-privacy: yes rotate if reused across projects. document salt lifecycle and store in KMS. no salts in plaintext in the repo.
chris-eng: noted. pinging @legal-bot for DPA check and required addenda.
legal-bot: automated reply: vendor must sign DPA + security addendum referencing encryption, access controls, breach notification timelines. see template: https://redwood.internal/legal/dpa-template. open ticket DPA-5421 for this vendor.
deploy-bot: approval request created (#APP-9987) — reviewers requested: ben-security, julie-privacy. attach sample and redaction log to speed review.
sara: thanks — i'll attach a 200-row sample, redaction script, and pii-scan output. aiming for EOD.
ben-security: also retention note: do not keep vendor copies longer than 30 days unless explicitly approved by security + legal. record approval in ticket.
julie-privacy: export rules: never include raw user_id columns in exports. if consumers need IDs, provide hashed_id + documented salt handling and access control.
chris-eng: copying the redaction checklist into infra runbook and opening a PR. will tag @ben-security and @julie-privacy for review.
sara: :thumbsup:
